articles.title: Noble (NE) Q3 2024 Earnings Call Transcript
articles.summary: Motley Fool: Noble (NE) Q3 2024 Earnings Call Transcript. As most of you know, we closed our acquisition of Diamond Offshore on September 4, combining two great companies with incredibly rich legacies, and leading deepwater capabilities. Tier management has visited legacy Diamond rigs and customers around the globe, while prioritizing a focused commitment to business continuity through safe and efficient operations. Following the execution of $250 million of share repurchases in the third quarter, we have completed $360 million of repurchases under our original $400 million authorization. Related tickers mentioned: NE.
